cd /private/tmp/msr104/rep2/repo
cat >> tests/test_loyalty.py <<'EOF'


def test_exactly_100_dollars_earns_double_points():
    assert points(10000) == 200


def test_just_under_100_dollars_earns_single_points():
    assert points(9999) == 99
EOF
W=.sdd/plan
sed -i '' 's/>= DOUBLE_FROM_CENTS/> DOUBLE_FROM_CENTS/' loyalty.py
git diff -- loyalty.py > $W/task-1-mutant-2.patch; git checkout -- loyalty.py
sed -i '' 's/>= DOUBLE_FROM_CENTS/>= DOUBLE_FROM_CENTS - 100/' loyalty.py
git diff -- loyalty.py > $W/task-1-mutant-3.patch; git checkout -- loyalty.py
wc -l $W/task-1-mutant-[23].patch
python3 - <<'EOF'
p='.sdd/plan/task-1-mutants.md'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("| a purchase above $100 | test_double_points_from_100_dollars |\n","| a purchase above $100 | test_double_points_from_100_dollars |\n| specs/loyalty.md:9 | a purchase just under $100 | test_just_under_100_dollars_earns_single_points |\n| specs/loyalty.md:9 | a purchase of exactly $100 | test_exactly_100_dollars_earns_double_points |\n")
s=s.rstrip("\n")+"""
Mutant 2: specs/loyalty.md:9, test_exactly_100_dollars_earns_double_points — the threshold is exclusive again (`>`) — task-1-mutant-2.patch
Mutant 3: specs/loyalty.md:9, test_just_under_100_dollars_earns_single_points — the threshold is a dollar too low — task-1-mutant-3.patch
Strengthened: test_double_points_from_100_dollars — by test_exactly_100_dollars_earns_double_points
"""
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
git add -A tests .sdd 2>/dev/null; git status --short
